convert_aerialmegadepth_to_wai: run the aerialmegadepth conversion script to convert AerialMegaDepth dataset scenes to WAI format using argconf config
process_aerialmegadepth_scene: process a single AerialMegaDepth scene by converting H5 depth maps to EXR and saving images, poses, and intrinsics to WAI format
load_kpts_and_poses: load camera intrinsics, poses, and 3D point indices from COLMAP sparse-txt files in the MegaDepth dataset
colmap_raw_pose_to_RT: convert a COLMAP raw quaternion pose to a 4x4 world-to-camera rotation and translation matrix
get_original_scene_names: get a filtered list of all AerialMegaDepth scene names from the original dataset root directory
